task_welcome_survey.title: Welcome Opinion Survey
task_welcome_survey.description: Complete our introductory survey to help tailor relevant questions to your profile and earn instant starter coins.
task_welcome_survey.proofHint: Submission is verified automatically. Proof is optional.
task_welcome_survey.terms: Must submit honest answers. Single completion per user account.

task_setup_payout.title: Add Payout UPI / Paytm
task_setup_payout.description: Add and verify your UPI ID or Paytm wallet in your profile to prepare your account for instant coin cashouts.
task_setup_payout.proofHint: Add payment method inside profile settings. No external proof required.
task_setup_payout.terms: Must be an active and valid payment handle.

task_join_telegram.title: Join Official Telegram Channel
task_join_telegram.description: Subscribe to our official Telegram channel for daily promo codes, high-reward opinion drops, and app notifications.
task_join_telegram.proofHint: Tap the link and join. Proof is optional.
task_join_telegram.terms: Stay subscribed to retain reward coins.

popup_welcome.title: Welcome to Cash Opinion!
popup_welcome.body: Share your opinions, complete easy tasks, spin the wheel, and withdraw real money directly to UPI or Paytm.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content: Welcome to Cash Opinion. By using this service, you agree that rewards and coin redemption are subject to compliance reviews. Multi-accounting, emulator exploitation, VPN tampering, or automated bots will result in immediate termination of access and forfeiture of balances.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Cash Opinion collects minimal device information and account credentials solely for fraud prevention and payout fulfillment. We do not sell or rent your information to third-party advertisers.

faq_1.question: How do I earn coins in Cash Opinion?
faq_1.answer: You earn coins by answering opinion surveys, daily check-ins, spinning the wheel, scratching cards, and inviting friends.

faq_2.question: What is the coin conversion rate?
faq_2.answer: 1,000 coins equal ₹1 INR. Minimum withdrawal is 5,000 coins (₹5).

faq_3.question: How are task submissions approved?
faq_3.answer: Proof is optional for standard tasks. Once submitted, administrators review the submission and award coins directly to your wallet.

faq_4.question: How long do withdrawals take?
faq_4.answer: Withdrawal requests are processed within 24 to 48 hours directly to your verified UPI ID or Paytm wallet.

tmpl_incomplete.text: The required task steps were not completed.

tmpl_invalid_details.title: Invalid Details
tmpl_invalid_details.text: The submitted information could not be verified.

tmpl_duplicate.text: This task was already completed by this account or device.
